cd apps/web && pnpm test -- --watch

git diff HEAD~1 -- apps/web/src/components/highlight.ts
git commit -m "fix(web): colour shell arguments"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
ls -la ~/.claude/projects/ | grep -v '^total'
find . -name '*.ts' -not -path './node_modules/*' -exec wc -l {} + | sort -n | tail -5
grep -rn "TODO" src/ --include='*.ts' | wc -l
curl -s -X POST localhost:8787/api/runs \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this repo","cwd":"/workspace"}' | jq .
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD:/workspace" -e CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN ghcr.io/example/agentry:latest
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
echo $HOME $USER ${PWD} $? $# $$ $1
ps aux | grep '[n]ode' | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill
tar -czf backup.tgz --exclude=node_modules .
ssh user@host 'cd /srv && ./deploy.sh' < /dev/null
sudo systemctl restart nginx; sudo journalctl -u nginx -n 50 --no-pager
python3 -m http.server 8000 &
kill %1
test -d dist && rm -rf dist
mkdir -p out/{a,b,c}
cp -r src/ dist/ && chmod +x dist/*.sh

sed -i 's/foo/bar/g' file.txt
awk -F: '$3 >= 1000 { print $1 }' /etc/passwd
xargs -n1 -P4 echo < list.txt
time (sleep 1; echo done)
source ~/.bashrc
